source_text: Sinistra eius sub capite meo, et dextera illius amplexabitur me. Sinistra temporalium dispensatio; dextera aeternorum donatio. Adiuro vos, filiae Hierusalem, per capreas cervosque camporum, ne suscitetis neque evigilare faciatis dilectam, donec ipsa velit.
pass_a_gloss: Left of-him under head my, and right of-him will-embrace me. Left of-temporals dispensation; right of-eternals gift...
pass_b_english: [[His left hand under my head, and his right hand will embrace me >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:6]]. The left is dispensation of temporal things; the right gift of eternal things. [[I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles and stags of the field, not to raise or awaken the beloved until she please >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:7]].
